label: LAST_CONSTITUTIVE_SUBSTAGE_1: A greatest operation index n such that no operation indexed by a…
definition: A greatest operation index n such that no operation indexed by a larger natural number belongs to the task. This is different from a limit endpoint at which an output may be evaluated.
note: Explicitly isolates the proposed last-step requirement instead of equivocating between a last member of the operation sequence and a separate endpoint. Whether actual completion necessarily requires such a member is an open philosophical premise.
